name: Aoze 1.1.2
bodyHtml:
Aoze 1.1.2: Clip gets the tools edits need, without getting complicated.

New

  • Smart Reframe: turn a clip into 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5. The frame follows what matters (the moving subject, or the cursor and changing panels on a screen recording) and moves smoothly, instead of always cutting the centre.
  • Speed: Slow, Fast, a ready-made Ramp, or your own curve. Changes are eased, slow parts get new in-between frames, and the sound follows at the same pitch.
  • Color: LUTs, with six built-in looks or your own .cube files, and an intensity slider. They also work with HDR output.
  • Beat Sync: a zoom punch or a short shake on the beat of the clip's music. If there is no clear beat, nothing is added and Aoze says so.
  • Glow: a soft light around bright areas.
  • Clip presets: Anime Smooth, TikTok Smooth, Cinematic and Clean. Hover a preset to see exactly what it turns on.

Improved

  • Smooth Motion on anime: drawings held for two or three frames are now interpolated between, so the motion is fluid on every frame instead of stop-and-go.
  • Smooth Motion has a Fast / Balanced / High quality choice. If the graphics card runs out of memory, it switches to a lighter setting instead of failing.
  • Motion blur has an intensity slider, and follows speed changes: faster parts get a longer smear.
  • The Clip panel is grouped into Motion and Color, with effects and fine settings folded away.
  • Before / After stays in sync when the speed changes, and switches to side by side when the shape changes.

Download Aoze_1.1.2_x64-setup.exe, run it, done (FFmpeg and every engine are included).
Aoze 1.1.0 and later update themselves: they offer the new version when it is out.
The installer is per-user (no admin rights). It is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen
may show "Windows protected your PC": choose "More info", then "Run anyway".
